transcript: Customer: It's too expensive. Salesperson: We can offer a 10% discount if you sign today. Customer: Still not sure...
Customer: I don't have time right now. Salesperson: Okay, I will call you next year. Bye.
Customer: We use competitor X. Salesperson: That's a great product! What do you feel is missing from their offering?
Customer: I need to talk to my manager. Salesperson: Makes sense. Would it help if I joined that meeting to answer technical questions?
